CanErrorCounters.description: Receive and transmit error counters of CAN1, copied from the error status register by CAN1_SE_IRQHandler (0x080032F8). Field names follow the CAN error counter names (probably REC and TEC).

fields.name: rx_error_count
fields.description: CAN1 receive error counter (probably ESR REC, bits 16..23). Sent as the first byte of telemetry request 0x341.

fields.name: tx_error_count
fields.description: CAN1 transmit error counter (probably ESR TEC, bits 24..31). Sent as the second byte of telemetry request 0x341.
